title: Materials with different heat capacity
hook: Change specific heat capacity and predict heat needed.
misconception: heat needed stays fixed when specific heat capacity doubles.
objective: Apply Q = mcΔT to compare heat needed when specific heat capacity changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With fixed mass and temperature change without a phase transition, Q = mcΔT. When specific heat capacity doubles, heat needed becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = mcΔT; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider fixed mass and temperature change without a phase transition, with a nonzero initial result. If specific heat capacity triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on heat needed?
recall.why: Apply Q = mcΔT under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
